name: kilimcininkoroglu-mods
description: Claude Mods (function-hooks plugins) for Claude Code.

plugins.name: task-poke
plugins.description: Submits a continue prompt when a main-loop turn ends while the TodoWrite or Task tools list still has unfinished tasks, at most 5 times in a row. Turns the task tools on for every model unless CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS is set. Reach L2: one $.prompt.submit per turn, reads the transcript, sets one env variable, stores one boolean.

plugins.name: limit-watch
plugins.description: Shows the subscription usage limits under the prompt with a reset countdown and a projection, opens a /limits pane, and logs once when a limit passes 80% and 95%.

plugins.name: memory-save
plugins.description: Loads ~/.cli-tweaks/memory/<project>/MEMORY.md into the session at startup, /clear and compaction, and saves project learnings to it after every main-loop turn through a tool-less $.model.fork in the background, so the stop is never blocked and no memory edit reaches the transcript. Shows the result on its status line.

plugins.name: cache-warm
plugins.description: Keeps the 1-hour prompt cache warm for a window you set with one tool-less $.model.fork per idle stretch, stops the moment a ping finds the cache gone, arms a six-hour window after a paid cold write, and shows the cache state, the cold price and this session's cold writes with /cache-status.

plugins.name: prompt-time
plugins.description: Draws the time under each of your messages and each text block of the model's replies in the transcript, the time alone for today and the date too for older ones, also for the messages of a resumed session. Display only: nothing reaches the model.

plugins.name: gemini-compact
plugins.description: Moves compaction from Claude to Gemini. Summary mode (default): Gemini summarizes the conversation and the newest messages stay verbatim. Prune mode: every message stays and Gemini keeps, truncates or drops each older tool call. /gemini-compact sets the mode, on/off and the automatic threshold; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

plugins.name: gemini-advisor
plugins.description: A Gemini advisor the model calls by itself: Gemini reads the whole conversation and the model's message and answers with a second opinion as the tool result. /gemini-advisor sets on/off; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

plugins.name: gemini-review
plugins.description: Gemini reviews each Bash git commit the model makes: the diff and the conversation. A blocker (a bug, data loss, a security hole, a committed secret) stops the commit and the model reads why; minor notes reach the model after the commit; a failed review lets the commit run with a warning. /gemini-review sets on/off; gemini-core holds the key, tier, model and thinking level.

plugins.name: gemini-core
plugins.description: One place for the Gemini settings of every Gemini mod: the keys and the tier for all, the model and the thinking level for each. Adds $.gemini, which builds each mod's Gemini request, reads the answer and moves to the next key after a quota or key error. /gemini-core sets them and picks a model from Google's model list.

plugins.name: flaky-memory
plugins.description: Remembers which tests failed on which code and tells the model when a failing test also passed on the same code, so it treats a flaky test as flaky.

plugins.name: gemini-plan-review
plugins.description: Has Gemini review each plan before it reaches you, and sends a plan with a blocking finding back to the model, at most twice.

plugins.name: disk-janitor
plugins.description: Measures the build artifacts of the project, shows them on the status line above 5 GB, and deletes the ones you pick in the /janitor pane; data directories are never listed.

plugins.name: contract-watch
plugins.description: After the model changes a function signature with Edit, lists the callers ripwire finds, so the model fixes them before the build does.

plugins.name: doc-drift-watch
plugins.description: After each commit the model makes, tells it which doc lines that commit made stale, from ripwire doc-drift.

plugins.name: prompt-deck
plugins.description: Learns the short prompts you send often in this project, draws them with the ones you pin, above the prompt; a digit key sends one at once.

plugins.name: shot-inline
plugins.description: Draws each PNG or JPG the model saves or reads under its tool row, in a terminal that shows pictures.

plugins.name: diagram-render
plugins.description: Renders the mermaid blocks of the model replies with an installed mmdc and draws each picture under its reply.

plugins.name: dep-sentinel
plugins.description: Checks each package the model installs against its registry and OSV.dev, and stops a missing, brand-new, look-alike, outdated or vulnerable one.

plugins.name: edit-loop
plugins.description: Tells the model when it has edited the same file five times in one turn, so it re-reads the root cause instead of trying again.

plugins.name: i18n-watch
plugins.description: Tells the model when an edit uses translation keys that one or more locale files lack.

plugins.name: env-sync
plugins.description: Tells the model when a commit reads env variables that .env.example lacks.

plugins.name: sql-concat-watch
plugins.description: Tells the model when an edit builds SQL by joining strings instead of passing query parameters.

plugins.name: lockfile-sync
plugins.description: Tells the model when a commit changes the dependencies of a manifest but not its lockfile.

plugins.name: bg-tasks
plugins.description: Shows the background shell tasks of the session on the status line, and stops one from the /bg pane.

plugins.name: action-pin
plugins.description: Notes each GitHub Actions step an edit pins to a moving tag, with the commit SHA to use instead.
